title: Citak language
description: Trans–New Guinea language spoken in Indonesia
extract: Citak or Kaunak is the Papuan language of Citak-Mitak district (kecamatan), Mappi Regency, Indonesia. It is called by its speakers Kau Adagum, Citak is an exonym from the Awyu people. Tamnim Citak is a distinct dialect. Diuwe is unverified as a language.
